attempts.summary: Configured a dedicated uploader key on node2 and a source-bound forced-command ingest identity on node1. Each SSH submission is stored byte-for-byte as a separate receipt. Shells, arbitrary commands, PTYs, and forwarding are blocked. Existing receipts, the sample batch, Ubuntu 16.04, and kernel 4.4.0-210 were preserved. Both nodes passed serial restart and recovery verification.
